events.text: During recess, older kids dare you to knock three times on the old boiler room door behind the {transportMode} stop and summon the legendary Headmaster's Ghost.

choices.label: Knock three times boldly
choices.resultText: You knocked firmly. A grumpy groundskeeper threw an empty bucket at you, proving ghosts wear overalls.

choices.label: Charge a fee in sweets to do the dare
choices.resultText: You collected half a dozen sugar candies from gullible classmates before nonchalantly tapping the door.

choices.label: Warn them about electrical hazards instead
choices.resultText: You explained the boiler room was merely condemned for rusted pipes. Boring, but responsible.

events.text: A superstitious classmate corners you before the {primaryExam}, offering a battered ballpoint pen allegedly blessed by an eccentric hermit that 'never writes a wrong answer'.

choices.label: Trade your favorite snack for the pen
choices.resultText: The pen leaked black ink all over your palm, but the placebo confidence helped you breeze through the {primaryExam}.

choices.label: Mock the superstition and study your notes
choices.resultText: You relied on genuine revision instead of sorcery and finished the {primaryExam} with clean fingers.

choices.label: Report the scam to the teacher
choices.resultText: The teacher confiscated the hermit pen and scolded your classmate for running classroom extortion.

events.text: A transfer student with your exact first and last name arrives at school, triggering an administrative disaster with report cards and lunch accounts.

choices.label: Team up with your namesake for harmless chaos
choices.resultText: You answered roll call for each other and confused the entire faculty for an entire term.

choices.label: Politely request the principal fix the paperwork
choices.resultText: The administration added middle initials to the school register, restoring bureaucratic order.

choices.label: Compete fiercely to be the top namesake
choices.resultText: You spent weeks trying to outperform your doppelganger on every single pop quiz.

events.text: Someone filmed you dozing off awkwardly on a packed morning {transportMode} with a half-eaten snack in your mouth. By nightfall, your face is a viral meme.

choices.label: Lean into the fame and launch official meme merchandise
choices.resultText: You monetized the viral clip, collecting royalties directly into your {moneyApp} account.

choices.label: Lie low and wear dark sunglasses on public transit
choices.resultText: You hid behind dark shades on the {transportMode} for three weeks until internet attention moved on.

choices.label: Post an unhinged parody video mimicking yourself
choices.resultText: The self-mocking video gained another million views, turning you into a local campus icon.

events.text: A trendy beverage startup notices your viral meme fame and wants to feature your sleeping face on billboard ads across the city.

choices.label: Sign the commercial endorsement deal
choices.resultText: Your face was plastered on billboards overlooking the highway, and an endorsement check landed in {moneyApp}.

choices.label: Demand creative control and direct the commercial
choices.resultText: You turned the ad into a hilarious avant-garde short film that won a regional marketing award.

choices.label: Decline to preserve your privacy
choices.resultText: You turned down the corporate money to enjoy a peaceful, unphotographed commute.

events.text: A probate lawyer contacts you with a wax-sealed letter: an eccentric grand-uncle you never met has bequeathed you an ocean shipping container full of vintage ceramic figurines.

choices.label: Pay the shipping depot clearance fee via {moneyApp}
choices.resultText: You cleared the container. Thousands of miniature porcelain gnomes now fill your rented storage unit.

choices.label: Sell the unopened container as a blind auction mystery lot
choices.resultText: A curious bargain hunter bought the unopened container for cash. Quick turnaround, zero headaches.

choices.label: Disclaim the bizarre inheritance immediately
choices.resultText: You declined to get entangled in deceased relatives' eccentric hoards.

events.text: An antique appraiser inspecting your inherited ceramic container gasps: three of the dust-covered figurines are museum-grade 18th-century royal porcelain.

choices.label: Consign the rare antiques to an international auction house
choices.resultText: Bidding was fierce! The auctioneer hammered down the lot for a life-altering windfall.

choices.label: Donate the treasures to the national heritage museum
choices.resultText: The museum unveiled a gallery plaque bearing your family name in gratitude for your cultural philanthropy.

choices.label: Keep them on your living room mantelpiece as quirky decor
choices.resultText: You placed the priceless relics next to your television, treating museum antiquities like bookends.

events.text: You step into a premier financial branch to check your {moneyApp} balance. The branch manager bows deeply, whispering '{greeting}', mistaking you for an elusive timber baron.

choices.label: Politely clarify your real identity
choices.resultText: The manager blushed furiously, apologized profusely, and offered you complimentary espresso.

choices.label: Play along to enjoy the executive VIP lounge snacks
choices.resultText: You feigned quiet aristocratic exhaustion while eating imported pastries and sparkling water.

choices.label: Nod mysteriously and leave before security notices
choices.resultText: You gave a dignified wave, stepped into the street, and laughed all the way to your bus stop.

events.text: While waiting for the {transportMode}, a runaway capuchin monkey wearing a tiny velvet waistcoat leaps onto your shoulder and clutches your coat.

choices.label: Check its collar for contact info and call the owner
choices.resultText: A frantic diplomat arrived in a luxury sedan, thanking you with a handsome cash reward.

choices.label: Share half your sandwich and take a selfie
choices.resultText: The photo gained thousands of likes before municipal animal services arrived to gently coax the creature down.

choices.label: Scream in shock and bolt away
choices.resultText: You ran down the avenue in panic, giving fellow commuters an impromptu comedy routine.

events.text: At a contemporary gallery opening, you accidentally set your spilled cup and crushed sandwich on an empty white pedestal. Art critics gather in awe.

choices.label: Nod sagely and explain it represents modern suburban decay
choices.resultText: An eccentric collector bought the 'installation' on the spot for serious money. You are officially an artist.

choices.label: Apologize and quickly wipe the pedestal clean
choices.resultText: The critics sighed in disappointment, claiming you just destroyed a post-industrial masterpiece.

choices.label: Slip away silently into the crowd before someone scolds you
choices.resultText: You watched from the free wine bar as attendees snapped photos of your discarded garbage.

events.text: A loud crash shakes your pantry. Your eccentric neighbor emerges through a hole in your basement wall covered in dust, greeting you with a bewildered '{greeting}'.

choices.label: Help them patch the wall over tea and biscuits
choices.resultText: Your neighbor explained they were excavating a root cellar and miscalculated the boundary line.

choices.label: Demand immediate repair compensation via {moneyApp}
choices.resultText: They transferred funds instantly from their phone to cover professional mason repairs.

choices.label: Ask if the secret tunnel leads anywhere interesting
choices.resultText: It only led to their laundry room, but the sheer absurdity made you lifelong friends.

events.text: A courier drops a silver envelope on your doorstep. Inside is a brass token and a cryptic invite to a midnight meeting of the 'Order of the Gilded Compass'.

choices.label: Attend the midnight gathering out of curiosity
choices.resultText: You arrived at an old hall where hooded figures were eating artisan pizza and debating philosophy.

choices.label: Toss the envelope straight into the recycling bin
choices.resultText: You have too many real-world bills to deal with strange secret club drama.

choices.label: Try to sell the antique brass token online
choices.resultText: An eccentric collector bought the curious token within an hour of posting.

events.text: The senior council of the Gilded Compass evaluates your standing and offers you an honorary patronage chair, opening exclusive old-money networking circles.

choices.label: Accept the patronage seat and expand your network
choices.resultText: The guild's influential alumni helped you secure lucrative commercial introductions.

choices.label: Suggest turning the society into a charity foundation
choices.resultText: Under your guidance, the quirky society began funding local youth community centers.

choices.label: Resign gracefully to avoid secret society drama
choices.resultText: You bowed out with a polite handshake, preferring a normal unencumbered life.

events.text: You shared a photo of a bizarre late-night fusion sandwich you cooked. Suddenly, twenty food courier alerts chime on your phone with prepaid orders sent through {moneyApp}.

choices.label: Raid your pantry and actually assemble the orders
choices.resultText: You spent two frantic hours flipping sandwiches and earned a handsome accidental profit.

choices.label: Issue immediate refunds with an apology note
choices.resultText: You canceled the accidental listings and enjoyed your midnight sandwich in peace.

choices.label: Call a friend with a restaurant to fulfill the orders
choices.resultText: Your friend's kitchen handled the rush and sent you a finder's commission.

events.text: A futuristic delivery drone spins out of control and crash-lands in your garden, dropping a heavy weatherproof case marked 'Confidential Hardware Prototype #404'.

choices.label: Contact the tech company's hotline and return the unit
choices.resultText: The company's vice president personally wired you a reward and praised your integrity.

choices.label: Crack open the case and test the prototype VR headset
choices.resultText: The holographic graphics blew your mind before the remote self-destruct firmware wiped the drive.

choices.label: Auction the damaged carbon-fiber drone parts for scrap
choices.resultText: You sold the rare brushless motors and titanium frame to a robotics hobbyist.

events.text: Between the yellowed pages of a secondhand textbook you bought to study for the {secondaryExam}, you discover an unpublished spy thriller manuscript.

choices.label: Transcribe the novel and submit it to a literary agency
choices.resultText: A publishing house snapped up the manuscript, paying you an advance as discoverer and editor.

choices.label: Track down the original author from marginal notes
choices.resultText: The retired author was moved to tears by the return of their lost manuscript and mentored your writing.

choices.label: Use the blank backs of the pages for {secondaryExam} scratch math
choices.resultText: You solved complex equations on the back of intense action scenes. Pragmatic to the core.

events.text: You get into a polite squabble over a downtown parking spot with a driver whose sedan sports foreign diplomatic plates and a sovereign flag.

choices.label: Yield the spot gracefully with a courteous '{greeting}'
choices.resultText: The diplomat was so impressed by your manners that they handed you an invite to an embassy reception.

choices.label: Stand your ground and point to the parking meter rules
choices.resultText: The diplomat huffed about the Geneva convention but drove away to look elsewhere.

choices.label: Offer to guide them to an open VIP garage nearby
choices.resultText: They tipped you generously for the local parking tip and thanked you warmly.

events.text: While reading the local morning gazette over coffee, you discover a full-page obituary praising your life, accomplishments, and untimely 'passing'.

choices.label: Call the editor to demand a retraction and free newspapers
choices.resultText: The mortified editor sent a glowing apology correction and a lifetime subscription.

choices.label: Show up at your friends' morning coffee club like a ghost
choices.resultText: The screams followed by hysterical laughter made it the most memorable morning of the decade.

choices.label: Read all the heartfelt compliments and bask in the praise
choices.resultText: Few people get to read their own eulogies while sipping hot tea. It was surprisingly uplifting.

events.text: The municipality unearths a municipal time capsule buried decades ago during a memorable {holidayName}. Your childhood letter is chosen to be read aloud.

choices.label: Embrace your goofy childhood predictions proudly
choices.resultText: The crowd roared with laughter at your prediction that everyone would commute via personal rocket boots.

choices.label: Hide in the back of the crowd pretending it's someone else
choices.resultText: You watched discreetly as neighbors chuckled at your ambitious youthful doodles.

choices.label: Donate a modern artifact to the next 50-year capsule
choices.resultText: You sealed a modern memory into the new capsule, continuing the generational tradition.

events.text: A candid smartphone clip of you singing soulfully while waiting for a {transportMode} goes viral, catching the ear of a famous indie recording producer.

choices.label: Record a guest track at their professional studio
choices.resultText: The single hit regional charts! You proved talent has no expiration date.

choices.label: Perform a one-night-only guest appearance at a community theater
choices.resultText: The venue gave you a standing ovation, and proceeds went to local music education.

choices.label: Politely decline and sing in the shower only
choices.resultText: You chose peaceful domestic serenity over late-life tour bus chaos.

events.text: An odd, dusty landscape painting you bought at a street stall for pocket change catches the eye of an art history professor visiting your home.

choices.label: Have it professionally restored and authenticated
choices.resultText: It was a lost canvas by an acclaimed 19th-century master! You sold it to an art foundation.

choices.label: Gift the painting to a national university gallery
choices.resultText: The university named a student scholarship in your honor to celebrate the discovery.

choices.label: Keep it in your hallway because you genuinely like the colors
choices.resultText: Guests now stare at your hallway art in silent reverence whenever they visit.

events.text: Two rival branches of your extended family both book major dinners for {holidayName} and demand you attend theirs or cause a generational feud.

choices.label: Sprint between both houses to attend both meals
choices.resultText: You ate two enormous festive dinners in three hours. Exhausting, but diplomatic peace was preserved.

choices.label: Host a neutral joint potluck at your place
choices.resultText: Burying the hatchet over good food and holiday cheer brought the entire family back together.

choices.label: Feign an urgent {transportMode} breakdown and stay home
choices.resultText: You watched movies and ate leftovers in glorious solitude, avoiding all holiday drama.

events.text: An eccentric philanthropist walking down your street offers to transfer funds via {moneyApp} to anyone who can beat him in a best-of-three game of rock-paper-scissors.

choices.label: Play with strategic game-theory psychology
choices.resultText: You anticipated his scissors with rock on the deciding round! The transfer arrived instantly.

choices.label: Play randomly with pure gut instinct
choices.resultText: You tied twice and squeaked out a win with paper. The billionaire cheered and paid up.

choices.label: Decline and advise the crowd to watch out for cameras
choices.resultText: You walked past calmly, deciding not to participate in billionaire street spectacles.

events.text: While replacing water pipes beneath your floorboards, you discover a heavy iron safe from 1952 embedded in the foundation stone.

choices.label: Hire a master locksmith to crack the dials
choices.resultText: Inside were uncirculated vintage banknotes and pristine mint silver coins!

choices.label: Carefully drill it open yourself with power tools
choices.resultText: After hours of sparks and grease, you popped the latch and found antique pocket watches.

choices.label: Leave it sealed as a mysterious house quirk for future generations
choices.resultText: You tiled over the inspection hatch, leaving the mystery intact for future homeowners.

events.text: A genealogical research institute sends you certified documents indicating you are 14th in line to the throne of a tiny, sovereign mountain principality.

choices.label: Fly out on vacation to inspect your supposed ancestral territory
choices.resultText: The village council greeted you with warm alpine pastries and made you an honorary castle patron.

choices.label: Frame the royal parchment and hang it behind your desk
choices.resultText: It makes for an extraordinary conversation starter during dinner parties.

choices.label: Politely decline all royal titles to stay a humble citizen
choices.resultText: You have no desire to navigate royal protocol or micro-nation border disputes.
